name: Brother Tithe
place: walks the roads around Halsbridge collecting "tithes" for a church that does not exist
_doc: Stream E (M2). A fake friar with a real mace. He marks someone for the tithe (a soak: someone must step in or everyone pays), blesses himself with an interruptible prayer that heals, and at half health throws holy-water flasks in a scatter.

party.solo: Solo: you are always the farthest, so you always soak — fine.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: "Blessings, traveller! The tithe is one purse. Or two. Faith is expensive."
Brother Tithe rattles his collection box menacingly.
say.death: Brother Tithe drops his box. It is full of buttons.
say.reset: Brother Tithe goes looking for more generous travellers.

tithe.name: Tithe Due
tithe.say: "The tithe falls due!" — somebody stand in the circle!

telegraphs.failSay: Nobody paid the tithe — the whole road is fined!

prayer.name: Pious Prayer
prayer.say: Brother Tithe kneels to pray for his own health — stop him!
